document.title: Ship emoji as one zip so the VPK installs and uploads fast
document.summary: Configure packs the 4009 Twemoji PNGs into `assets/emoji/twemoji.zip`, and the emoji loader reads single entries from that zip instead of opening one file per emoji.
document.why: Installing the VPK and uploading the emoji were slow because [the Vita's filesystem and VitaShell's FTP handle many small files badly](source:s1).

sources.label: PR #148
sources.title: perf(vita): ship emoji as one zip so the VPK installs and uploads fast
sources.gist: One zip instead of ~4000 PNGs; VPK goes from 4021 to 13 files; rendering unchanged.

groups.title: Configure packs the Twemoji PNGs into one zip
groups.why: The zip has to exist before anything can read it; this group produces it with CMake alone.
groups.summary: `twemoji.cmake` passes the new `PACK twemoji.zip` option, and `vitadeck_fetch_asset` lands the stripped PNG names in a staging folder, then runs `cmake -E tar --format=zip` over them.

attention.note: With `PACK`, the stamp name gains a `-twemoji.zip` suffix, so an existing checkout's `Twemoji-<sha>` stamp no longer matches. Reconfigure then downloads again, deletes the loose PNGs the old stamp lists, and writes the zip. An offline reconfigure during that upgrade builds without emoji until the next online one.

fileNotes.cmake/fetch_asset.cmake: Adds the `PACK` option, the stamp suffix, and the zip step.
fileNotes.cmake/twemoji.cmake: Turns on `PACK twemoji.zip` for the Twemoji download.

groups.title: The emoji loader reads entries from the zip
groups.why: Without a reader, the zip is just a file the host cannot draw from.
groups.summary: `emoji_pack_open` indexes the zip's central directory into an stb_ds string map, `load_emoji_image` in `fonts.c` opens the pack on the first emoji and inflates only the named entry, and `glyph_cache_harness` walks every pack entry through the same path.

attention.note: `emoji_pack_read` accepts only deflated entries (method 8), because that is all `cmake -E tar --format=zip` writes. A stored entry from another zip tool reads as a missing emoji and draws the fallback glyph. The pack `FILE *` stays open from the first emoji until `font_registry_shutdown`.

fileNotes.src/ui/emoji_pack.c: New zip reader: central-directory index plus raw inflate per entry.
fileNotes.src/ui/emoji_pack.h: Open, close, enumerate and read API for the pack.
fileNotes.src/ui/fonts.c: Loader reads from the pack; shutdown closes it.
fileNotes.tests/glyph_cache_harness.c: Twemoji cases iterate pack entries; adds missing and non-zip pack cases.

groups.title: Vita uploads send the one zip
groups.why: The FTP upload of thousands of PNGs is the slow path the change removes.
groups.summary: `upload_vita` now sends `twemoji.zip` with one `curl -T`, still guarded by the per-IP stamp, and `bench.sh` drops the comment about the hour-long first emoji upload, since its missing-file listing now finds one file.

fileNotes.CMakeLists.txt: Replaces the generated curl config with one upload of the zip.
fileNotes.scripts/bench.sh: Drops the stale comment about uploading 4000 emoji.

groups.title: Docs name the zip
groups.why: The skills and the Twemoji README described the loose PNGs and their slow upload.
groups.summary: Wording-only updates that say the emoji ship as `assets/emoji/twemoji.zip`; you can skim them.

fileNotes..agents/skills/vitadeck-build/SKILL.md: Says the emoji download lands as one zip.
fileNotes.assets/emoji/README.md: Notes the images are packed into `twemoji.zip`.

commits.subject: feat(ui): ship the Twemoji images as one zip
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The Vita's filesystem and VitaShell's FTP server are slow with thousands of
small files, so installing the VPK and uploading the emoji took minutes.
Configure now packs the 4009 PNGs into assets/emoji/twemoji.zip, and the
emoji loader reads single entries from it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
